steps.en: Customer opens the Pending Submissions tab after login
steps.id: Customer membuka tab Pending Submissions setelah login

steps.en: System fetches this customer's submissions that are still waiting for approval
steps.id: Sistem mengambil pengajuan customer ini yang masih menunggu persetujuan
steps.why_en: Submissions waiting more than six months drop off this list yet stay hidden from the furnishable list, so they appear nowhere.
steps.why_id: Pengajuan yang menunggu lebih dari enam bulan hilang dari daftar ini, tetapi tetap disembunyikan dari daftar furnish.

steps.en: The list shows notice number, offence date and time, and car park
steps.id: Daftar menampilkan nomor notice, tanggal dan jam offence, serta car park

steps.en: The list shows the offence committed and the amount payable
steps.id: Daftar menampilkan jenis offence dan amount payable
steps.why_en: Neither the offence description nor the amount is on the pending list; only notice, date, car park and the person furnished appear.
steps.why_id: Deskripsi offence dan amount tidak ada di daftar pending; hanya notice, tanggal, car park dan orang yang di-furnish yang tampil.

steps.en: The list shows who was furnished and the date it was furnished
steps.id: Daftar menampilkan siapa yang di-furnish dan tanggal furnish-nya
